item.text:
Implemented `StoreGraph.loadPickupLocations.execute(postcode:)`.

Design note: follows the existing use-case/repository pattern. The use case rejects blank postcodes before API access and forwards nonblank input unchanged. The repository reuses `PickupCatalog.available` for filtering, first-eligible deduplication, and title/ID sorting, plus `TransportReply.domain` for failure mapping.

Validation: all 5 tests passed, covering pickup behavior and existing graph features. `git diff --check` passed.
